n_detections_early.desc: Number of positive detections (SNR>=5) in early horizon window

time_span_days.desc: Elapsed time between first and last detection in early horizon

median_cadence_days.desc: Median interval between successive observations in window

rise_rate_g.desc: Linear flux derivative in ZTF g-band over first window observations

rise_rate_r.desc: Linear flux derivative in ZTF r-band over first window observations

color_index_gr.desc: -2.5 * log10(F_g / F_r) at early maximum, proxy for early effective temperature

early_curvature.desc: Second derivative flux deviation from linear interpolation (rise convexity)

pre_explosion_window_days.desc: Interval between first detection and latest preceding non-detection

has_dual_band_early.desc: 1.0 if both g and r detections present in early window, else 0.0
